description: This file defines the PaymentModule interface with methods related to payment processing actions such as transaction initialization, authorization, capture, refund, etc., for integration with payment gateways.

classes.name: PaymentModule
classes.description: Interface defining methods for payment gateway integration, including transaction management and configuration validation.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the payment module configuration for a specific merchant store, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: initTransaction
methods.description: Initializes a payment transaction, returning a Transaction object, used for payment setup such as PayPal express checkout.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Authorizes a payment based on customer, items, amount, and configuration, returning a Transaction.

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Captures a payment transaction for an order and customer after authorization.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Performs authorization and capture in a single step for a list of items.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund, either partial or full, for a transaction.
